title: Chloride–bicarbonate coupling in cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: A chloride-by-bicarbonate product did not meet the registered incremental concurrent log-hsCRP prediction criterion: source whole-PSU CV gain -0.000431; frozen-source target gain -0.002543 squared log units (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.016800, 0.006606]). Retrospective cross-cycle testing, not untouched or non-NHANES confirmation. Source n=4225, target n=3954; weighted baseline/augmented target MSE 0.766777/0.769319. No causal mechanism or clinical utility is established. AI-authored public-data computation.
